guideWarning: Body band includes raised arms; head includes a partly hand-occluded chin in B. Numbers cannot prove limb-volume equivalence under different poses.

entryPlan.E1: Begin raising viewer-left forearm from the low pose; slight brow engagement. Keep skull/shoulders and foot registration stable; prepare weight transfer.
entryPlan.E2: Forearm reaches mid chest; progressively focus eyes. One foot begins the outward step; jacket folds follow the moving elbow.
entryPlan.E3: Fingertips approach the chin, expression nears B. The other foot completes the wider stance; trouser contours follow leg rotation rather than inflating volume.
entryPlan.E4: Settle into the exact frozen B pose, completing the fingertip contact, fist and suit detailing. No final-frame body rescale or newly replaced face.
constraints: Each adjacent step needs actual manual visual QA
Head size/center remain near the already Feng endpoint
Track hand trajectory and planted/supporting feet
Do not hide another body-form change inside Entry
Do not use speed changes to conceal a bad connection

visualReview.reviewer: Codex primary agent, direct native and nearest-3x static image inspection

expression.reason: A direct cut replaces the relaxed eyes/brows and mouth reading with B's sharp focused expression, brighter hair shading and firmer facial lines. Entry should stage the expression rather than treating this as another Morph frame.

armTrajectory.reason: The viewer-left hand jumps from below the waist to the lips; elbow direction and jacket sleeve folds change substantially. The other hand shifts outward as the arm opens. Intermediate arm positions are required.

stance.reason: The narrow planted feet become B's wide stance. Sole-band centers move -17px and +18.5px; baseline equality does not make this a continuous step.

suitDetails.reason: The lapel, shirt, hem and trouser-fold arrangements change with the lifted arm and spread legs. A direct cut visibly changes these structures at once; the details should follow the staged pose.

formProportions.reason: Head guides differ only -1px per axis and body-band width +3px. Both poses read broad/strong, but arms and legs are differently oriented. Equal scalar bounds cannot prove exact limb-volume equivalence; the future entry art must check pose-normalized thigh/calf and torso volume, without concealing another body-form change.

visualReview.scope: static Entry audit and four-pose plan only; no Entry artwork or runtime test
